controls.title: Each financial institution or creditor must periodically determine whether it offers or maintains covered accounts. As a part of this determination, a financial institution or creditor must conduct a

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Each financial institution or creditor must periodically determine whether it offers or maintains covered accounts. As a part of this determination, a financial institution or creditor must conduct a risk assessment to determine whether it offers or maintains covered accounts described in paragraph (b)(3)(ii) of this section, taking into consideration: (1) The methods it provides to open its accounts; (2) The methods it provides to access its accounts; and (3) Its previous experiences with identity theft.

controls.title: Each financial institution or creditor that offers or maintains one or more covered accounts must develop and implement a written Identity Theft Prevention Program (Program) that is designed to detect

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Each financial institution or creditor that offers or maintains one or more covered accounts must develop and implement a written Identity Theft Prevention Program (Program) that is designed to detect, prevent, and mitigate identity theft in connection with the opening of a covered account or any existing covered account. The Program must be appropriate to the size and complexity of the financial institution or creditor and the nature and scope of its activities.

controls.title: Identify relevant Red Flags for the covered accounts that the financial institution or creditor offers or maintains, and incorporate those Red Flags into its Program;

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identify relevant Red Flags for the covered accounts that the financial institution or creditor offers or maintains, and incorporate those Red Flags into its Program;

controls.title: Detect Red Flags that have been incorporated into the Program of the financial institution or creditor;

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Detect Red Flags that have been incorporated into the Program of the financial institution or creditor;

controls.title: Respond appropriately to any Red Flags that are detected pursuant to paragraph (d)(2)(ii) of this section to prevent and mitigate identity theft; and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Respond appropriately to any Red Flags that are detected pursuant to paragraph (d)(2)(ii) of this section to prevent and mitigate identity theft; and

controls.title: Ensure the Program (including the Red Flags determined to be relevant) is updated periodically, to reflect changes in risks to customers and to the safety and soundness of the financial institution or

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ensure the Program (including the Red Flags determined to be relevant) is updated periodically, to reflect changes in risks to customers and to the safety and soundness of the financial institution or creditor from identity theft.

controls.title: Obtain approval of the initial written Program from either its board of directors or an appropriate committee of the board of directors;

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Obtain approval of the initial written Program from either its board of directors or an appropriate committee of the board of directors;

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Involve the board of directors, an appropriate committee thereof, or a designated employee at the level of senior management in the oversight, development, implementation and administration of the Program;

controls.title: Train staff, as necessary, to effectively implement the Program; and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Train staff, as necessary, to effectively implement the Program; and

controls.title: Exercise appropriate and effective oversight of service provider arrangements.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Exercise appropriate and effective oversight of service provider arrangements.

controls.title: Any person who maintains or otherwise possesses consumer information for a business purpose must properly dispose of such information by taking reasonable measures to protect against unauthorized acce

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Any person who maintains or otherwise possesses consumer information for a business purpose must properly dispose of such information by taking reasonable measures to protect against unauthorized access to or use of the information in connection with its disposal.
